items.name: Turf-Reeve's Tally Ring
items.lore: Fergal counts every block of turf that leaves Siopa. This was his old tally-ring.

items.name: Wayguard-Iron Bracer
items.lore: Siabra bog-iron, cold and heavy.

items.name: Cullen Gold Collar Charm
items.lore: A link from the gold collar Tomas cut out of the turf. Bronze Age gold, warm as skin.

items.name: Peat-Cutter's Belt
items.lore: Tomas's own. The buckle is a turf-spade.

items.name: Post-Captain's Seal Ring
items.lore: Siabra captains seal their orders with light. This seal still glows.

items.name: Stilt-Walker's Boots-Charm
items.lore: The siabra build their posts on stilts over the water.

items.name: Causeway-Breaker's Torc
items.lore: Bog-oak and bronze, from the causeway's first post.

items.name: Lantern-Pole Bracer
items.lore: Cut from one of the poles that carried the lights.

items.name: Glowing-Page Charm
items.lore: A page of Lorcan's verse that glows in the dark.

items.name: Harper's Wrist-Cord
items.lore: Fiona's spare harp-strings, braided.

items.name: Muse's Kiss Pendant
items.lore: Cold silver, shaped like lips. It whispers rhymes.

items.name: Burnt-Verse Ring
items.lore: Ash from a burned book of poems, sealed in glass.

items.name: Wayguard's Bracer
items.lore: Siabra bog-iron, cold and heavy.

items.name: Bog-Creeper Cloak
items.lore: Woven from the vines of bog creepers. It moves a little on its own.

items.name: Unlit Muse Ring
items.lore: A muse's ring, with the light gone out of it.

items.name: Keener's Reed Belt
items.lore: Brid weaves them from the reeds the lights won't touch.

items.name: Keening-Stone Charm
items.lore: A chip of the banshee's stone. It's always cold.

items.name: Wraith-Mud Bracer
items.lore: Black iron from the bog, where the drowned dead walk.

items.name: False-Keener's Veil Charm
items.lore: Riolda's veil, the light gone out of it.

items.name: Keener's Black Belt
items.lore: Worn at every keening in Cullen for a hundred years.

items.name: Steward's Ledger Ring
items.lore: The ring Conn sealed the household's accounts with. And other things.

items.name: Blue-Wax Charm
items.lore: Azure sealing wax, still bright.

items.name: Keener's Veil
items.lore: Sadhbh's own. She has keened for three chieftains in it.

items.name: Poisoner's Vial Pendant
items.lore: Empty now. The glass is very fine - sidhe glass.

items.name: Venator's Ring
items.lore: From the hand of a siabra assassin.

items.name: Black Wraith Bracer
items.lore: The black wraiths of Cullen are the dead who drowned in the bog. This one wore iron.

items.name: Chieftess Dana's Brooch
items.lore: The Chieftess' own brooch, given in thanks.

items.name: Crossed-Crown Ring
items.lore: The Azure wear the Glimmer King's crown crossed out. So do you, now.

items.name: Torch-Bearer's Bracer
items.lore: Scorched blue iron.

items.name: Pitch-Black Charm
items.lore: A lump of the Azure's pitch, set in silver. It still smells of smoke.

items.name: Banisher's Belt
items.lore: An Azure banisher's belt, hung with blue glass.

items.name: Idol-Breaker's Ring
items.lore: The idolaters carry little crowns of light to burn. This is one, broken.

items.name: Cleanser's Smoke-Cloak
items.lore: It smells of smoke for ever.

items.name: Marshal's Blue Torc
items.lore: Cathbarr's torc of blue enamel, cracked.

items.name: Mantle of Alainn Bin
items.lore: The Clann's own, for those who broke the Azure on the north road.

items.name: Crow-Feather Charm
items.lore: A feather Badb dropped over the battle. It's warm.

items.name: Bog-Light Lantern Charm
items.lore: A dead bog-light in a glass bead. It flickers when the Glimmer is near.

items.name: Wisp-Reader's Ring
items.lore: Brid reads the lights by the colour. This ring helps.

items.name: Ward-Shard Bracer
items.lore: From a glimmer ward, the tower's door-keepers.

items.name: Three-Gem Belt
items.lore: Three chips of the tower's great gems, set in leather.

items.name: Battle-Crow's Pinion Torc
items.lore: A pinion feather of Badb's, bound in bronze.

items.name: Cronicorn Horn Ring
items.lore: Badb's unicorns are black, and very old.

items.name: Lantern-Bearer's Glass Torc
items.lore: The lantern-bearer's lamp, broken and bound. Dark now.

items.name: Mantle of the Keen
items.lore: The Keeners' own, for those who put out the tower's light.

items.name: Dark-Gem Ring
items.lore: A chip of the red gem, dark.
